item.description:
I am a PhD student at the University of Washington working in the Natural Language Processing Group and the Machine Learning Group. I am advised by Professor Yejin Choi. My research centers on using deep learning to discover commonsense knowledge and simulate commonsense reasoning.

I am also a researcher on the Mosaic Project at the Allen Institute for Artificial Intelligence and collaborate extensively with Asli Celikyilmaz on the Deep Learning Team at MSR. Check out my CV for more details.

I’m always happy to discuss projects with prospective researchers and have advised multiple students throughout my time at the University of Washington.
